$comment: The shapes the web server's own routes write and read (server.go, response.go), beside the catalogue's; the generator of api.v2.schema.json copies these $defs as they are. Change them with the Go that writes them.

web.Version.description: GET /api/version: the version of the binary that serves.

web.Repo.description: A repository wtm knows, as GET /api/repos lists it: its id, the {repo} of a route, and where it is.

id.description: A digest of its common directory.

common_dir.description: git rev-parse --git-common-dir, absolute: the repository's key.

web.Repos.description: GET /api/repos: the repositories wtm knows, those no longer initialized left out.

web.Command.description: A command of the catalogue as GET /api/repos/{repo}/commands lists it: its name and its form outside any repository.

web.Call.description: The body of POST /api/repos/{repo}/commands/{name} and of its /questions: the answer of each field by its path, and, to run it, whether it plans only and the fingerprint its apply is held to.

web.Warning.description: The data of an event named warning on an event stream: what kept a line or a repository from it for a while.

web.Busy.description: POST /api/stop refused, 409: the correlation IDs of the operations still running.

web.CommandLine.description: POST /api/command-line: a follow-up as the command line runs it.

web.Refusal.description: The body of a request the server refuses itself, before any command runs: a v2 envelope of no command, its error one of the server's codes.

error.description: Its code is the server's own (web.token_invalid, web.host_refused, web.origin_refused, web.not_found, web.repo_unknown, web.command_unknown, web.operation_unknown, web.schema_unavailable, web.stopping), request.invalid for a body that does not decode, or the code of what failed while the repositories were read.
